title: Finite semisimplicial sets, differential graded algebras, and cellular sheaves
summary: We develop a differential graded model for finite non-singular semisimplicial sets and their cellular sheaves. To a finite non-singular semisimplicial set \(S\), we associate an exterior DGA \(Ω^\bullet_S\), extending the classical anti-equivalence between finite simple directed graphs and first-order differential calculi to higher degrees. We characterize the essential image of this construction, obtaining an equivalence of categories that recovers the graph-FODC correspondence in dimension one.
